youtube.title: Why Is Coca-Cola Red? Not Santa, Tax Agents 🥤 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Why is Coca-Cola red? Most people say Santa Claus, but that's backwards. In the 1890s the syrup shipped in wooden barrels, just like whiskey. Alcohol was taxed and soda was not, so the company painted its barrels red to tell a tax agent at a glance: no whiskey here. Red became the signal long before Santa. Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #Coke #History #Facts #thehiddenwhy
